latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor AI List — AI-powered video editing with a simple chat workflow.

- Upload video and audio files (up to 500MB) and get AI-edited outputs by describing your desired edits.
- No manual timeline or sliders: just chat prompts like "trim silences, add transitions, and export a clean final cut."
- Automated session, authentication, and cloud job handling with feedback on process and errors.
- Export final edits as 1080p MP4 and monitor credits, status, and timeline details in real time.
- Clear mapping of common editing requests and error handling, with support for popular formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MP3, WAV, etc.).
- Built for fast results for content creators and marketers without video editing expertise.
